modes.name: α · mode (1, 0)
modes.note: learned mode: turning it moves the hour hand forward and the minute hand backward

modes.name: β · mode (1, 1)
modes.note: learned mode: turning it moves only the minute hand

modes.name: natural hour · α
modes.note: change of basis: turn α and β together, only the hour hand moves

modes.name: natural minute · β · conj(α)
modes.note: change of basis: phase of β minus phase of α; turning it moves only the minute hand
